feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Greetings from Edinburgh, where a cheeky tour guide makes art history hilarious
entry.summary: For anyone who grew up staring blankly at museum artwork, this is the fun that was missing: Coco leads interactive and (mostly) factual art history comedy tours.

entry.title: Is Nepal's flood a harbinger of what's to come in the Himalayas?
entry.summary: Building dams and hydropower plants in the Himalayas holds great promise for providing electricity. In the wake of the Nepal disaster, experts are asking about the risks of such construction.

entry.title: Dems have an edge over GOP, poll finds. And, ICE looks into 'mobile detention centers'
entry.summary: An NPR poll shows that Democrats have an edge over Republicans going into the midterms, partially due to Trump. And, Immigration and Customs Enforcement is looking into "mobile detention centers."

entry.title: Will FDA advisers recommend a multi-cancer blood test for approval? They'll vote
entry.summary: The company Grail says its Galleri blood test can detect up to 50 forms of cancer. An independent panel of experts will decide if the test should be recommended for FDA approval.

entry.title: DOJ defends White House media ban, urges court to reject lawsuit
entry.summary: The Department of Justice defended President Trump's recent media ban, arguing that reporting by CNN, MS Now and Politico on a wide range of issues jeopardized national security and spread falsehoods.

entry.title: Major news outlets banned by Trump will have their day in court
entry.summary: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are asking a federal judge to hold the president in check for what they say is a violation of their Constitutional rights simply because he doesn't like how they cover him.

entry.title: As Congress confronts AI, Senate lawmakers are shut off from its most advanced tools
entry.summary: While Senate offices have access to chatbots like ChatGPT, they are not authorized to use any of the more advanced tools that are at the center of regulatory talks and public debate about AI safety.

entry.title: How an 'AI freeze' could make big AI companies bigger and hurt smaller firms
entry.summary: Critics say a slowdown of AI development among the largest companies could consolidate the power of frontier labs, just as many others are trying to catch up.

entry.title: There's growing concern that Trump may deploy the National Guard ahead of elections
entry.summary: Fears are growing that President Trump may deploy the U.S. military to polling places in the upcoming elections, despite strict state and federal laws against such a move.

entry.title: ICE is looking into 'mobile detention facilities'
entry.summary: Buried in the paperwork for Immigration and Customs Enforcement's expansion in Pennsylvania is a document requesting "mobile detention facilities."
